text:
mira: quick follow-up: propose a lightweight 'accept-frame' from edge->client right after ingestion. purpose: give clients a clear 'accepted' state so UIs stop auto-retrying and so edge can try a non-destructive 'suppress' handshake on cancel.

ben: new frame vs trailers? trailers arrive at end so not useful.

mira: right. frame is immediate and tiny: {accept_mode: fast|durable, suggested_retry_ms}. fast = edge-local, durable = wait for backend persist.

alex: risk: edge fast accept then crash -> client thinks request is accepted but it was lost.

mira: tradeoff. default fast for low-latency gen. durable opt-in for sensitive routes.

sara: suppress-handshake could hide duplicates; forbid on side-effectful routes and require idempotency keys.

mira: agreed. route config gates suppress and durable.

ben: billing? do not bill on accept. bill when backend produces tokens or on completion. accept only telemetry.

ops-bot: rollout-note: feature=accept-frame, layer=edge, canary=5%->25% over 72h starting 1745600000. watch: accept_latency_p95, suppress_timeout_count, duplicate_retry_rate.

mira: I'll write the RFC with state machine, sequence diagrams, SDK hint (accepted + suggested_retry_ms) and observability plan. posting draft tomorrow. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
